Our mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful is as relevant today as it was when we were founded in 1998. Since then, we have evolved from a company that helps people find answers to a company that also helps people get things done.", "text_hash": "5f2ed3aa2e92eb17b139afd9de88454624c870c84dd6be9f05f133ad55991d7a", "type": "paragraph"}, {"block_id": "block-000062-ab181097", "image_asset_id": null, "layout_role": null, "ordinal": 62, "reported_page": 3, "source_anchor": "i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19", "table": null, "text": "We are focused on building an even more helpful Google for everyone, and we aspire to give everyone the tools they need to increase their knowledge, health, happiness, and success. YouTube provides people with entertainment, information, and opportunities to learn something new and helps support the creator economy through the YouTube Partner Program. Google Cloud helps customers build for the future, improve productivity, reduce costs, and unlock new growth engines. We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach, which spans AI-optimized infrastructure; world-class research, including models and tooling; and our products and platforms that bring AI to billions of people, developers, and enterprises.", "text_hash": "46037f96e9a42e04c3de8e91e2ea63e4e35ae207d0c7f57cdd4eda9cfa16640a", "type": "paragraph"}, {"block_id": "block-000067-8371f0be", "image_asset_id": null, "layout_role": null, "ordinal": 67, "reported_page": 4, "source_anchor": "i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19", "table": null, "text": "At the foundation of our full-stack approach is our AI-optimized infrastructure — a key differentiator enabling us to power our own products, such as Search and YouTube, and support the services we provide to our Google Cloud customers. 仍是“广告现金牛 + 云业务加速 + AI 资本开支上行”的组合，但当前最重要的变化不在于它是否会继续增长，而在于增长的质量正在被AI重塑。10-K显示，公司把自己定义为由Google Services、Google Cloud和Other Bets组成，另有一部分AI研发在Alphabet层面集中管理；同时它明确把AI视为公司与业务的关键平台转变，并把AI基础设施、TPU/GPU和数据中心效率视为差异化能力。换言之，Alphabet不是单纯的搜索公司，而是把搜索、YouTube、Cloud和自研AI基础设施捆在一起的系统性平台公司。"},{"citations":[{"block_id":"block-000790-942753de","document_id":"alphabet-000165204426000018","index_id":"didx-028173790917c679","quote":""},{"block_id":"block-000911-3342f7dd","document_id":"alphabet-000165204426000018","index_id":"didx-028173790917c679","quote":""}],"kind":"fact","text":"从收入结构看，Google ads为403.67亿美元。管理层对业务的描述也一致：Services主要靠广告、订阅、平台与设备变现，Cloud主要靠按使用量收费和订阅。"}],"title":"初始判断"},"earnings":{"paragraphs":[{"citations":[{"block_id":"block-000742-53762a3b","document_id":"alphabet-000165204426000018","index_id":"didx-028173790917c679","quote":""},{"block_id":"block-000914-d9c3ca1b","document_id":"alphabet-000165204426000018","index_id":"didx-028173790917c679","quote":""}],"kind":"fact","text":"2025年Alphabet的经营结果很强，但利润结构开始显示出“增长更快、投入更重”的特征。合并收入为4028.36亿美元，同比增长15.2%；营业利润1290.39亿美元，同比增长14.9%；净利润1321.70亿美元，同比增长32.0%，这其中部分来自其他收入净额显著改善到297.87亿美元。分部上，Google Cloud收入同比增长35.9%至587.05亿美元，营业利润增至139.10亿美元；Google Services收入同比增长12.4%至3427.21亿美元，营业利润1394.04亿美元；Other
